pieces.Text: Through researching lengthy, ancient, arcane scripts, you have discovered a more efficient method of recording spells. This method was originally developed by the Cyphermages of Riddleport, but has been spreading through the Inner Sea region recently. Any spell you scribe in your spellbook costs half as much as normal and takes up only half the room it normally would (round all fractions up). It only takes you 10 minutes/spell level to scribe a spell into your spellbook (5 minutes for cantrips).
